title: What to do in a mental health crisis
citation: Leaune, E., & Bui, E. (2025). A (global) mental health crisis? International Journal of Mental Health, 54(4), 414-416.
content:
What to do in a mental health crisis.

A mental health crisis is a period when emotional distress becomes so overwhelming that it feels difficult to cope or function as usual. During these times, it is important to focus on immediate support rather than trying to solve every problem at once. Reaching out to a trusted person or a mental health professional can help reduce the sense of isolation and make it easier to take the next step. A crisis is temporary and support can make a significant difference.
